name: 98445 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98445 (Tacoma) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98445 (Tacoma) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
